تحتووا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوُوا (taḥtawū) /taħ.ta.wuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
# تُحْتَوَوْا (tuḥtawaw) /tuħ.ta.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
